usedFor: Speech is Cheap turns audio into text, and “Create a New Transcription Job” starts a job from an audio URL.

bestTemplate.name: “Create a New Transcription Job” in Speech is Cheap
bestTemplate.why: It starts a transcription job from an audio file URL, so recordings turn into text.

watchOut: “Create a New Transcription Job” needs an audio file URL, so check each record carries one.
